svg.title: How a day is split
svg.desc: Each segment of a day, an attack window or a benign stretch, is split by time into 60 percent train, 10 percent validation and 30 percent test, with a 120 second gap at every boundary so no flow straddles two splits. Every split therefore contains every attack family. Measured over five days the events fall 69.4 percent train, 6.0 percent validation, 20.2 percent test and 4.3 percent in gaps.
